question: In the direct recycling of lithium-ion battery electrodes by solvent recovery with ethylene glycol, how much capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell retain after its 1000 cycles?
rendered: The 1.4 Ah lithium-ion pouch cell retained 65.7% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles.
